prompt: tell me about the band LCD soundsystem and why did james murphy start it
response: LCD Soundsystem was formed in 2002 by James Murphy, a former employee of DFA Records. Murphy started the band as a side project to test out new sounds and ideas outside of his work responsibilities. The band's name is a reference to Liquid Crystal Display technology, reflecting Murphy's interest in the intersection of technology and music. LCD Soundsystem quickly gained a following for their unique blend of indie rock and electronic dance music, becoming one of the most influential bands of the 2000s.
